title: Compare fractions
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review
about: Teacher-verified mastery check. Written separately from the practice generators: students write the sign themselves, put fractions in order, explain, and solve word problems. Each item is worth 1 point. 'math' is the calculation behind the item, used only by the test that checks the answer key.
directions: Show how you know. A picture, a common denominator, or comparing to one half all count.

items.prompt: Write <, = or > to make it true:  {7/10} ☐ {4/10}
Write <, = or > to make it true:  {2/9} ☐ {1/2}
Write <, = or > to make it true:  {5/6} ☐ {7/9}
Put these in order from least to greatest:  {2/3}, {3/8}, {5/6}
Maya ran {3/4} of a mile. Luis ran {4/5} of a mile. Who ran farther? Show how you know.
Jordan says {3/8} is bigger than {3/5} because 8 is bigger than 5. Is Jordan right? Explain.
Write <, = or > to make it true:  {5/12} ☐ {11/12}
Write <, = or > to make it true:  {9/8} ☐ 1
Write <, = or > to make it true:  {4/7} ☐ {3/5}
Put these in order from least to greatest:  {3/4}, {1/6}, {7/12}
One pitcher is {2/3} full and another is {5/8} full. Which pitcher has more juice in it? Show how you know.
Sam says {4/5} and {6/7} are equal because each is one piece away from a whole. Is Sam right? Explain.
